title: A study plan
description:
Order courses so every prerequisite comes first, with a topological sort.

```
plan: basics, loops, functions, arrays, structs, pointers, lists
cycle check: "a needs b, b needs a" -> impossible
```
hints: For each pair, the course has one more unmet need, and the prerequisite gets the course in its "unlocks" list (lesson 5.02).
If the plan has fewer courses than there are courses, the rest are stuck in a cycle.
requirements: Kahn's algorithm: start with courses that need nothing, and keep a count of unmet needs.
When there is a cycle, say so instead of printing a partial plan.
stretch: Group the plan into terms: everything with no unmet needs at the same time goes in one term.
